byteward.sentence: Tallow DB, the popular open source database, is moving to a source-available license.
The new license applies starting with version 9.0.
Under it, cloud providers can't sell Tallow DB as a hosted service without a commercial agreement with Tallow DB Inc., the company behind the project.
Versions released before 9.0 stay under the old open source license, so nobody loses access to code they already use.

launch-desk.sentence: Tallow DB is switching to a source-available license.
Cloud companies will need a paid deal to offer it as a service.
The company behind it, Tallow DB Inc., says rival cloud hosts were undercutting its own hosted service.
That service, Tallow DB Cloud, brings in 70% of the company's revenue.
The company raised $95 million in July.
